# Sordino v0.4.2

Windows patch release: **Sordino no longer hogs the CPU while it starts**, which could make other apps (browsers, games, music players) play scrambled or stuttering audio for a few seconds after boot.

## What's Fixed (Windows)

- **Model load no longer runs at audio priority.** Loading the neural denoiser used to happen inside the real-time "Pro Audio" (MMCSS) priority class. At boot, when Windows and many apps start at once, that load could starve other apps' audio threads. It now loads at normal priority and only enters Pro Audio once audio is streaming.
- **The optimized model is cached per process.** Parsing and optimizing a DPDFNet model costs hundreds of milliseconds of CPU. It used to be repeated on every restart (device change, hot-plug, boot-time retries). It is now done once per model, so restarts are instant and cheap.

No settings changes and no new files: just update.

## Install / Update

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cosmos-0118/Sordino/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**macOS (Terminal):**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cosmos-0118/Sordino/main/install.sh | bash
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/Sordino/compare/v0.4.1...v0.4.2
